tools.name: compare_strings
tools.description: Compare two strings (usernames, domains, brand or command names) with Unicode UTS #39 skeletons and say whether they can look the same to a reader: identical, confusable, confusable_ignoring_case or distinct. Also returns each string's scripts, whether it mixes scripts, and its skeleton. Up to 1024

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_text, compare_strings · Private data: scan_text · Public sink: scan_text, compare_strings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_text, compare_strings · Private data: scan_text · Public sink: scan_text, compare_strings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
